descriptionChirho: Indicates origin, source, or separation: 'from' a place, person, or thing, including movement away from or out of.
Used in comparisons to express 'more than' or 'greater than,' the so-called min of comparison.
Indicates a part taken from a whole: 'some of,' 'one of,' 'part of.'
Expresses cause, reason, or concern: 'because of,' 'on account of,' 'for,' sometimes shading into 'upon' or 'over.'
